homeDesc: Navigate using the sidebar to find election details, simulate EVM, or chat with our AI.
evmInstruct: Press the blue button to cast your mock vote. Wait for the beep. The machine locks after 1 vote.
noBooths: No booths found for this constituency.
boothInfo1: Carry your original EPIC (Voter ID) card or any of the 11 alternative photo identity documents approved by the ECI.
boothInfo2: Mobile phones, smartwatches, and cameras are strictly prohibited inside the polling booth.
boothInfo3: "Pink Booths" are managed entirely by women polling personnel and security staff.
boothInfo4: Accessible (PWD) booths feature ramps, wheelchairs, and braille EVMs.
timelineFact: The 2026 Assembly Elections will feature over 15.8 Crore eligible voters across 5 states, making it one of the largest democratic exercises of the year. The Election Commission of India strictly enforces the Model Code of Conduct to ensure free and fair polling.
eVoterGuideTitle: How to Get Your e-Voter ID (e-EPIC)
eVoterStep1: Go to the official Voter Services Portal:
eVoterStep2: Click on "e-EPIC Download" on the homepage.
eVoterStep3: Enter your EPIC number or mobile number registered with your Voter ID.
eVoterStep4: Verify using the OTP sent to your registered mobile number.
eVoterStep5: Your e-EPIC (digital Voter ID PDF) will download automatically. You can upload it directly here!
